dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Humans should break free of the shackles of the earth and soar into the skies! Don't you think so too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Err, you are...

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Antoine Roger's the name, and clockwork engineering's the game. My specialty? The eternal dream of humanity: flight!

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Now, you might be curious, and rightly so, as to how this might be different from Edwin Eastinghouse's research. In which case, let me explain!

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: I generate propulsion using energy converted from the annihilation reaction between pneuma and ousia, which powers my aircraft's movement!

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: What do you think? If you'd like to give it a try, hop aboard the Antoine Roger Aircraft and activate it using an annihilation reaction!

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: It will move along the designated path — accident-free travel guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: You have a wonderful day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it really safe?

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Absolutely, positively — according to my calculations and simulation experiments, that is!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this work for the Fontaine Research Institute?

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Ah, what are you talking about? The Institute has been rendered a ruin. Its capacity for research has been lost! All that remains is the official agency.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: But what cannot be denied is that many independent engineers — of whom I am one — still use kinetic cores designed by Guillotin, the Institute's founder.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: The aircraft is merely one step in the realization of my goals.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: My final objective is the creation of sufficiently powerful and affordable kinetic cores.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: I wish to attain greatness like that of Guillotin and build something that can change Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Imagine a nation as I envision it, dear friend. Humans freed from gravity, free to fly through the skies.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Clockwork meka shall perform all the labor we need on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: While we, having primacy over all other beings, shall be freed from such. We shall be free to think, to produce art, to develop culture!

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Is this not lovely?
